Title: Widgetry guide: cache settings
URL: https://docs.example.com/widgetry/cache
Published Date: 2025-01-20
Author: Ada Example
Text: Widgetry keeps rendered widgets in memory for five minutes.
Set `cache.ttl` to change the lifetime.
